alerts.name: Docker daemon 不可达
alerts.action:
1) 登录主机执行 systemctl status docker 确认 daemon 是否存活；
2) 执行 docker ps 手工验证，若卡住不返回说明 daemon 夯死，用 journalctl -u docker -n 200 查看日志定位；
3) 确认 /var/run/docker.sock 权限与采集账号是否匹配；
4) 确认磁盘（尤其 /var/lib/docker 所在分区）未写满，磁盘满是 daemon 夯死的常见原因。

alerts.name: Docker 容器健康检查失败
alerts.action:
1) 从告警标签取 container_name，执行 docker inspect <容器名>，看输出中 State.Health 字段里最近几次健康检查的输出；
2) 执行 docker logs --tail 200 <容器名> 定位应用报错；
3) 按健康检查命令手工复现（docker exec <容器名> <健康检查命令>）确认是应用故障还是检查命令本身写错；
4) 应用故障且短期修不好时，先把该实例从上游负载均衡摘除再排查。

alerts.name: Docker 容器被 OOM Kill
alerts.action:
1) 从告警标签取 container_name，执行 docker inspect <容器名> | grep -i memory 确认当前 limit；
2) 对照 docker_container_mem_max_usage 的历史峰值，判断是 limit 设太小还是应用内存泄漏；
3) limit 偏小则调大 --memory 后重建容器；
4) 疑似泄漏则在应用侧抓堆（Java 用 jmap、Go 用 pprof）定位，不要只靠调大 limit 掩盖问题。

alerts.name: Docker 容器反复重启
alerts.action:
1) 从告警标签取 container_name，执行 docker logs --tail 200 <容器名> 看每次退出前的报错；
2) 执行 docker inspect <容器名>，看输出中 State.ExitCode 退出码（137 通常是 OOM 或被 kill，1/2 多为应用自身启动失败）；
3) 配置或依赖问题（连不上数据库、配置文件缺失）先修复依赖再拉起；
4) 为避免持续刷日志占满磁盘，定位期间可先 docker stop 该容器并从负载均衡摘除。

alerts.name: Docker 容器内存使用率逼近上限
alerts.name_en: Docker container memory approaching its limit
alerts.action:
1) 从告警标签取 container_name，执行 docker stats --no-stream <容器名> 确认当前用量与 limit；
2) 对照历史曲线判断是持续爬升（疑似泄漏）还是业务高峰的正常波动；
3) 正常波动则调大 --memory 并预留 20% 余量后重建；
4) 持续爬升则在应用侧抓堆定位泄漏点，同时先把 limit 调高争取排查时间。

alerts.name: Docker 容器 CPU 被限流
alerts.action:
1) 从告警标签取 container_name，执行 docker inspect <容器名> | grep -iE 'cpuquota|cpuperiod|nanocpus' 确认当前配额；
2) 对照 docker_container_cpu_usage_percent 判断是业务量上涨还是应用出现忙等/死循环；
3) 业务量上涨则调大 --cpus 后重建容器，或水平扩容多个实例分摊；
4) 用量异常则在应用侧抓 CPU profile 定位热点函数。

collect.content:
# # collect interval
# interval = 15

[[instances]]
# # append some labels for series
# labels = { region="cloud", product="n9e" }

# # interval = global.interval * interval_times
# interval_times = 1

## Docker Endpoint
##   To use TCP, set endpoint = "tcp://[ip]:[port]"
##   To use environment variables (ie, docker-machine), set endpoint = "ENV"
# endpoint = "unix:///var/run/docker.sock"
endpoint = ""

## Set to true to collect Swarm metrics(desired_replicas, running_replicas)
gather_services = false
gather_extend_memstats = false

container_id_label_enable = true
container_id_label_short_style = false

## Containers to include and exclude. Globs accepted.
## Note that an empty array for both will include all containers
container_name_include = []
container_name_exclude = []

## Container states to include and exclude. Globs accepted.
## When empty only containers in the "running" state will be captured.
## example: container_state_include = ["created", "restarting", "running", "removing", "paused", "exited", "dead"]
## example: container_state_exclude = ["created", "restarting", "running", "removing", "paused", "exited", "dead"]
# container_state_include = []
# container_state_exclude = []

## Timeout for docker list, info, and stats commands
timeout = "5s"

## Specifies for which classes a per-device metric should be issued
## Possible values are 'cpu' (cpu0, cpu1, ...), 'blkio' (8:0, 8:1, ...) and 'network' (eth0, eth1, ...)
## Please note that this setting has no effect if 'perdevice' is set to 'true'
perdevice_include = []

## Specifies for which classes a total metric should be issued. Total is an aggregated of the 'perdevice' values.
## Possible values are 'cpu', 'blkio' and 'network'
## Total 'cpu' is reported directly by Docker daemon, and 'network' and 'blkio' totals are aggregated by this plugin.
## Please note that this setting has no effect if 'total' is set to 'false'
total_include = ["cpu", "blkio", "network"]

## Which environment variables should we use as a tag
##tag_env = ["JAVA_HOME", "HEAP_SIZE"]

## docker labels to include and exclude as tags. Globs accepted.
## Note that an empty array for both will include all labels as tags
docker_label_include = []
docker_label_exclude = ["annotation*", "io.kubernetes*", "*description*", "*maintainer*", "*hash", "*author*", "*org_*", "*date*", "*url*", "*docker_compose*"]

## Optional TLS Config
# use_tls = false
# tls_ca = "/etc/telegraf/ca.pem"
# tls_cert = "/etc/telegraf/cert.pem"
# tls_key = "/etc/telegraf/key.pem"
## Use TLS but skip chain & host verification
# insecure_skip_verify = false
